# ExpertsIA

> AI consulting agency for startups, SMEs and corporations. AI strategy, agentic
> workflows, RAG systems, data science, training. Based in France, working remotely
> and on-site. Founded by Cyril Marchand.

## Services
- AI Strategy & Roadmap — assess capabilities, build a custom AI adoption plan
- Business Process Optimization — AI + data to streamline operations (n8n, automations)
- Agentic Workflows — AI agents and RAG systems that automate complex tasks
- Data Science Projects — prediction models, clustering, recommendation engines
- AI Training & Enablement — LLMs, prompt engineering, hands-on workshops
- Change Management — structured AI adoption with stakeholder alignment
- AI Audit & Assessment — evaluate existing AI initiatives, gaps, governance
- Data Infrastructure — pipelines, warehouses, ETL for AI and analytics

## Pricing
Transparent per-project pricing, quoted after a free consultation.
Typical engagements: AI audit, agentic workflow builds, RAG systems, team training.

## Machine-readable actions (WebMCP)
- Action catalog: https://www.expertsia.dev/mcp-actions.json (declared in `<link rel="mcp-actions">`)
- Declarative forms: contact (request-ai-consultation), newsletter (subscribe-newsletter) on the home page
- Agent-callable API: POST https://www.expertsia.dev/api/teardown {"url": "https://example.com"} — structured 7-pass site teardown, paid via x402 (USDC on Base) or API key; first unpaid call returns HTTP 402 with terms
- Booking: https://cal.com/expertsia/audit — free 15-minute AI audit call
